Plugin.Name: LLDP for UNRAID
Plugin.Overview: Runs lldpd so the server announces itself to your switches over LLDP and shows which switch and port each interface is plugged into, under Settings > Network Services > LLDP and as a Dashboard tile. Choose which interfaces take part and which management addresses are advertised, override the system name and description, set the transmit interval, run receive-only, and optionally speak CDP, FDP, SONMP or EDP for older Cisco, Foundry, Nortel and Extreme gear. lldpd 1.0.22 runs with privilege separation. Maintained fork of desertwitch's LLDP for UNRAID.
